title: Synthesis of Chiral Calix[4]resorcinarenes via Mono-O-henzylation. Complexation Behavior with a Chiral Trimethylammonium Compound
abstract: Abstract                Chiral calix[4]resorcinarenes were prepared via mono-O-benzylation, and their conformational properties in solution were described. The complexation behavior of the heptahydroxy derivative with a chiral trimethylammonium compound in methanol was investigated by 1H NMR spectroscopy.
